No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The extended windsock retains an offset mast, overhead support, thick intake hoop with open centre and tapered fabric tube extending rightward. The mast/arm is simplified from a narrow outlined material strip to one continuous 1.4 mm line with the same attachment at the hoop top. Hoop thickness is widened and the upper/lower fabric attachment points are moved slightly around its contour to separate the fabric edge from the support joint. This static object layout does not encode wind speed, pressure or a motion arrow; ViewPlus remains unfilled.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The extended windsock retains an offset mast, overhead support, thick intake hoop with open centre and tapered fabric tube extending rightward.
